title: SARA analysis code and provenance for disease gene retrieval under uneven knowledge coverage
description: SARA V8.1 analysis source, frozen configurations, preprocessing scripts, environment specifications and content-hash provenance for the October 18 scientific manuscript snapshot and its October 28 English editorial revision. Creator: 徐嘉璐 (Jialu Xu). This release includes the original source dependency packages and bounded software/identity checks. It does not include third-party raw databases, processed research tables, fitted weights or saved prediction arrays. Original segmented V8 encoder arrays and the complete historical CTD raw dump are not retained; seed-42 replay additionally requires development-stage prediction artifacts. A full independent-environment numerical reproduction has not been completed. Third-party resources retain their original terms. No DOI is asserted by this metadata file.
